digest.component_or_area: rich-text codec cutover and state-based echo suppression
propositions: Cloud ADF codec and DC wiki codec must route send paths through render/normalize functions so that lossy round-trips converge within one pass and do not loop.
State-based echo suppression via persisted baseline diff (ADR-0026) requires local-side normalization in baseline compare while preserving emit-side comparison against plain inbound-decoded remote.

A change-gated inline 8-byte rich_sha counter, reset on wire change and cleared on baseline refresh, bounds non-idempotent re-emit loops to exactly one GET at threshold RICH_REEMIT_OBSERVE_AT=2 without per-pass timestamp overhead.

The cutover must tolerate no-extras install: markdown_to_adf, adf_to_markdown, fit_markdown_to_adf_limit degrade to plain-text adf.py fallback on ImportError, preserving contract that reconciler engine is dependency-free.
Concurrent both-sides body edit keeps rebar's body (local-wins per a713) and raises outbound-field-conflict alert; conflict resolution route remains unchanged.

Two distinct compose sites on DC (backend.py _map_local_to_dc_fields create path and _issues._translate_create_fields) must both apply to_wire(fit_outbound(...)) or ship un-rendered Markdown on CREATE while updates ship rendered wiki.
